name: Monport Reno 45 (2026)
tagline: Desktop 45W CO₂ with a 400 × 300 mm bed and built-in water cooling
tldr: Monport's new-generation Reno 45, listed on 20 September 2026, keeps the 400 × 300 mm bed and 45W glass tube but moves the water cooling inside (3 L tank) and adds a 470 × 7 mm front pass-through, 100 mm of Z travel and magnetic assisted focus. Basic $1,149.99 (500 mm/s, USB), Pro $1,499.99 (600 mm/s, Wi-Fi, offline panel, compatible with the 1W IR module), Vision $1,649.99 (8 MP camera). All three were on pre-order in October 2026: Pro and Vision shipping late October, Basic late November. It replaces the earlier Reno 45 Pro Vision.
mainObjective: An affordable first CO₂ for acrylic, wood and leather on a desk

priceRange.note: Official Monport store, Oct 2026: Basic $1,149.99, Pro $1,499.99, Vision $1,649.99, all on pre-order; the LightBurn bundle adds $99.99 (Basic) or $199.99 (Pro, Vision)

engraveExample.description: Filled photo or logo on birch plywood

cannot: Bare metal (except with the optional 1W IR module on Pro and Vision)

pros: Built-in 3 L water tank replaces the external tank the previous Reno 45 needed
Low entry price: $1,149.99 for the Basic, $1,649.99 for the camera-equipped Vision (Monport, Oct 2026)
470 × 7 mm front pass-through and 100 mm of Z travel for long strips and taller objects
cons: Pre-order only in October 2026: Pro and Vision ship late October, Basic late November
Tube rated 3,000 h below 40% power but 900 h above 70%, with a 6-month tube warranty
400 × 300 mm bed: half the area of the Reno 65, which costs $450 to $1,100 more depending on version

faq.question: What changed from the previous Reno 45?
faq.answer: Monport's own comparison lists three changes: the water cooling moves inside the machine (3 L tank, no external tank to set up), the air assist pump rises from 18 to 20 L/min and only runs during jobs, and the Pro and Vision accept a swappable 1W IR module for bare metal. The bed stays at 400 × 300 mm. The previous Reno 45 Pro Vision is no longer sold on Monport's store.

faq.question: Is the new Reno 45 available now?
faq.answer: Not yet. In October 2026 every version was a pre-order on Monport's US store: Pro and Vision with an estimated late-October ship date, Basic late November. Monport's own product page points buyers who need a machine right away to other models.

faq.question: Basic, Pro or Vision?
faq.answer: The Basic ($1,149.99) is USB-only, 500 mm/s, with LightBurn or LaserGRBL. The Pro ($1,499.99) adds 600 mm/s, Wi-Fi, U-disk, an offline control panel, AutoLaser and the mobile app, plus IR module compatibility. The Vision ($1,649.99) adds the 8 MP camera for placement, contour recognition and batch layouts in AutoLaser; at $150 more than the Pro, it is the version most buyers should look at first.

standoutFeatures.title: Water cooling now built in
standoutFeatures.body: The previous Reno 45 relied on an external tank. This generation carries a 3 L tank and radiator inside the chassis, which removes the bucket, pump and hoses from the desk.

standoutFeatures.title: A camera CO₂ under $1,700
standoutFeatures.body: The Vision version pairs an 8 MP full-bed camera with the 45W tube for $1,649.99 on Monport's store (October 2026, pre-order).

beginnerNotes: This profile covers the 2026 generation of the Reno 45, not the earlier Reno 45 Pro Vision. It suits a first CO₂ for gifts, signs and craft-fair products. Choose the Pro or Vision if you want Wi-Fi and the IR option; the Basic is USB-only.
proTips: Keep routine work under about 70% tube power to stay near Monport's longer life figures. Use the front pass-through for long strips. Duct the 100 mm exhaust outlet outside, even for short engraving jobs.

editorialDepth.advantages: The 2026 Reno 45 removes the old model's most awkward setup step, the external water tank, and lowers the price sharply. With a pass-through, 100 mm of Z travel and an optional IR module on the Pro and Vision, it covers most of what a home business needs from a first CO₂.
editorialDepth.limitations: It is a pre-order with no independent review of this generation yet. The bed is modest, focus is assisted rather than automatic, the glass tube is a consumable with a 6-month warranty, and smoke must be vented outside.
